ground_truth.answer: Earth's equatorial radius is 6378.137 km (commonly written 6,378.137 kilometers, i.e., 6378.137 x 10^3 m). This is the value stated on the NASA NSSDCA Earth Fact Sheet. NASA's JPL Solar System Dynamics gives the same figure to higher precision as 6378.1366 +/- 0.0001 km, and NASA Science's Facts About Earth corroborates it via an equatorial diameter of 12,756 km (radius ~6,378 km).
